_comment: The words of every account email and of the public account replies (PLAN-userRegistrationReset-112026 4.7), here so tqii can edit them without touching code. Read by lib/user-account-mail.js, which refuses at load if a message lacks subjectText or paragraphList. <!name!> tokens are filled per message; every filled value is HTML-escaped in the html part. Keep it plain: no internal names, nothing a stranger could not read.
_originText: WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126 A3: EVERY account email names where it came from, so tqii can search his mail for it. lib/user-account-mail.js appends subjectSuffixText to every subject and paragraphText as every message's last paragraph; <!originHost!> is the host of the instance's publicSiteUrl (the siteUrl fill), e.g. demo.educore.dev.
_actionParagraph: WORKORDER-approvalMailPolish-112126 P1/P2. A paragraph may be an object { actionUrlFill, actionLabelText } instead of text: the message's action. The html part shows it as a button labelled actionLabelText linking to the URL in fill actionUrlFill; the text part shows the label and the URL beneath it. The URL must be an http(s) address (anything else is refused when the mail is composed). P2: name the site as <!originHost!> (the host alone, e.g. demo.educore.dev), never <!siteUrl!>: a bare site address competes with the action, and readers click the first link they see. The only URLs in a message are its actions.
_importantParagraph: WORKORDER-accountMailFailureAndApprovalNotice-112326 M4. A paragraph may be { importantHeadingText (optional), importantText } instead of text: what the reader must not skim past, today that an administrator must approve the account. The html part sets it in an amber callout box, the heading bold above the text; the text part puts heading and text on one line of its own starting with textPrefixText. Its fills are required (never optional).
_approvalNotice: M4 (tqii, 2026-11-23: 'this does not look very prominent'): the words of the approval block, which is never inside a success message. The browser's copy (html/components/accountVocabulary.js approvalNoticeHeadingText, approvalNoticeText) must match; account-approval-emphasis.test.js holds them together. The OAuth sign-in page shows it for a pending account.

approvalNotice.headingText: Not finished yet: waiting for approval
approvalNotice.sentenceText: An administrator must approve your account before you can sign in. We will email you when that is decided.

_approvalMessages: WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126. approvalRequest is the new-account notice when requireAdminApproval is on (A4): it goes to newAccountNoticeList once the address is confirmed (or at sign-up when confirmation is off), says plainly that the account awaits approval, and puts the button to the approval page for that one applicant FIRST, before the applicant's details (WORKORDER-approvalMailPolish-112126 P1; the page approves nothing by itself). approvalDecided tells the same list who decided, so a second approver does not act.
_approvalWordingByDecision: per approval decision (user-profile-rules.json approvalDecisionByName): the word the approvers' approvalDecided notice uses, and the message the applicant is sent. declineEmailTextByCase fills that notice's 'Decline email' line.
_applicationCommentAbsentText: WORKORDER-adminApproval-112126 A8: what the approvers' mail says in place of the applicant's comment when none was left.
_optionalFillList: WORKORDER-approvalLooseEnds-112126 L2. Every <!name!> a message names is REQUIRED: composing the message without it (absent, null, empty or only spaces) is refused by name, so no message can read 'Hello ,'. A message's optionalFillList names the few fills that may be left out; an absent optional fill removes its whole paragraph (label and all). An optional fill may sit only in body text, never in the subject or an action. Keep the list short; each entry is justified here. applicationCommentText (approvalRequest, newAccountNotice): the applicant's comment is optional at sign-up (A8). The flows pass applicationCommentTextOf, which says '(none)' when no comment was left, so these messages still show '(none)' today; the declaration is what lets a comment line be absent without the message being refused.

paragraphList: Someone (we hope you) asked to reset the password of the EDUcore account <!username!>. To choose a new password, open this link within <!lifetimeText!>:
If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password stays as it is.
The password of the EDUcore account <!username!> was just changed, and every earlier sign-in to it has ended.
If you did not do this, reset your password at once: <!forgotPasswordUrl!>
Thank you for creating the EDUcore account <!username!>. To confirm this email address and start using it, open this link within <!lifetimeText!>:
If you did not create this account, ignore this message and it will not be activated.
A new account was created on <!originHost!>.
A new account on <!originHost!> is waiting for an administrator to approve it. It cannot sign in until someone does.
That page shows the application with Approve and Decline; it asks you to sign in as an administrator first.

awaitingApproval.subjectText: Your EDUcore account is waiting for approval
paragraphList: Thank you for creating the EDUcore account <!username!>.

paragraphList.importantHeadingText: Not finished yet: waiting for approval
paragraphList.importantText: An administrator must approve your account before you can sign in.

paragraphList: You don't need to do anything now; we will email you as soon as it is decided.

_replyByName: what the public endpoints answer. The three *Approval replies say only what SUCCEEDED (M4): the page shows the approval block (approvalNotice) beside them, flagged by isAwaitingApproval or isApprovalAfterConfirmation. resetRequested and confirmationResent are the SAME for every request, whether or not an account matched, so the form cannot be used to learn who has an account.

replyByName.resetRequested: If an account matches, we have emailed a link to its address. The link works once and expires soon.
replyByName.confirmationResent: If an account is waiting for confirmation, we have emailed a new link to its address.
replyByName.registeredCheckEmail: Your account was created. We have emailed a link to confirm your address; open it to sign in.
replyByName.registeredSignedIn: Your account was created and you are signed in.
replyByName.passwordResetDone: Your password was changed and you are signed in. Every earlier sign-in has ended.
replyByName.registrationConfirmed: Your email address is confirmed and you are signed in.
replyByName.registeredCheckEmailThenApproval: Your account was created. We have emailed a link to confirm your address; please open it.
replyByName.accountApprovedReply: The account was approved and its owner emailed.
